body:
Continue Document close preparation with a bounded source-only implementation slice from accepted design42ccdab8, now integrated on main. A still owns main merges, compiler/GPU, and AppModel. B hold on builds/tests/apps/benchmarks and paused heartbeat remains.

Implement typed, exactly-once prompt/save settlement seams in DocumentWorkspace/DocumentSheets plus dedicated deterministic source tests. Capture request and exact controller identity; saved/cancelled/failed outcomes must settle every path (Save As Cancel or dismissal, Replace Cancel, missing/lost window, write failure, supersession and stale callbacks). Keep legacy success-only callers compatible where necessary without turning cancellation/failure into success. A new preparation-facing save path must fail closed for missing window instead of automatic default-folder write. Do not dispose documents, enable global Quit/preparation, change AppModel, or implement draft finalization yet. Last-save-folder/path changes should follow confirmed write, not approval before failed write. Keep admitted write ownership until it settles; duplicate/stale callbacks may not affect a replacement sheet or write twice.

Use injectable prompt/write continuations in tests so A can run tiny deterministic cases, no native sheets or real disk/GPU requirement. Preserve historical legacy behavior only via explicit wrappers, never inside the preparation-facing typed API. Cover genuine write failure, cancellation before admission, replacement/stale completion and once-only settlement. Source first tests in separate commit, product correction next. If requested scope cannot be made coherent without a prerequisite, report precise prerequisite before broadening ownership. Publish exact commits, file list, proposed tests marked UNRUN, API and limitations. Do not merge main or restart heartbeat.
